**Best move:** Ra1+

**Main line:** Ra1+ Kb2 Rxh1 Rd8+ Nxd8 (Black is up a full rook)

**Motif:** fork (the check forces the king away, then Black captures the undefended rook)

**Coaching note:**

When your opponent has two pieces undefended on the same rank or line, a forcing check can often win material. Here, Ra1+ forces White's king to move, then your rook captures the undefended h1 rook with check still controlling escape squares. Even White's counterattack with Rd8+ loses the rook to your knight. Always scan for undefended pieces after forcing moves—they're often overlooked in tactical sequences.
